200.description: Artifact bytes; Content-Type matches artifact.media_type and Content-Disposition is attachment.

Range.description: Half-open interval [from,to); from must precede to.

BacktestCreate.description: Positive initial cash; all models and benchmark must be compatible. No implicit market, currency, zero fee or fill defaults.

JobEvent.description: Sequence is a string to avoid browser integer precision loss.

ResearchSeries.description: JSON artifact format for factor IC, coverage and grouped-return series; large outputs are split into ordered artifacts.

ComparisonResult.description: JSON artifact returned by a completed comparison job. Basis mismatches must remain visible.

Record.description: Field schemas and units are returned in record_schema; parent_id traces the causal chain.
